### Configure environment. Load data.
```{r warning=F}

source(here::here("0-config.R"))

#---------------------------
# requires the following data:
# b_preds_mort_raster2_s0,1,2,3
#---------------------------

```


```{r map predictions}

#--------------------------------------
# create and save mortality rate maps
# for all treatment arms
# (see function in washb-geopair-Functions.R)
#--------------------------------------


map_mort_s0 <- create_mort_map(raster2 = b_preds_mort_raster2_s0,
                               agetxt  = "(1 to 59)",
                               tagtxt  = "Overall")

map_mort_s1 <- create_mort_map(raster2 = b_preds_mort_raster2_s1,
                               agetxt  = "(1 to 59)",
                               tagtxt  = "Child Azithro")

map_mort_s2 <- create_mort_map(raster2 = b_preds_mort_raster2_s2,
                               agetxt  = "(1 to 59)",
                               tagtxt  = "Infant Azithro")

map_mort_s3 <- create_mort_map(raster2 = b_preds_mort_raster2_s3,
                               agetxt  = "(1 to 59)",
                               tagtxt  = "Placebo")

```
